Package dev.turboism.sdk.ui.appearance

Interface ControlAppearanceTarget

All Known Implementing Classes:
ControlAppearanceTarget.DeformerControlRow, ControlAppearanceTarget.DeformerLabel, ControlAppearanceTarget.ParameterFolder, ControlAppearanceTarget.ParameterLabel, ControlAppearanceTarget.PartFolder, ControlAppearanceTarget.PartLabel
public sealed interface ControlAppearanceTarget permits ControlAppearanceTarget.ParameterLabel, ControlAppearanceTarget.ParameterFolder, ControlAppearanceTarget.DeformerLabel, ControlAppearanceTarget.DeformerControlRow, ControlAppearanceTarget.PartLabel, ControlAppearanceTarget.PartFolder
Closed set of semantic native controls eligible for bounded appearance overlays.

Targets carry Turboism model IDs, never widget references. They can become unavailable after document lifecycle changes; runtime resolution must fail closed rather than rebinding a stale target to a similarly named host control.
